## v1.6.0 — 2026-03-17

Version 1.6.0 introduces a new Team Dashboard feature and includes important security fixes from the v1.5.0 audit addressing prototype pollution, rate limiting, input validation, and project capacity limits, along with API cache key corrections and edge-case handling improvements.

### ✨ Features

- Added Team Dashboard feature providing centralized team management and visibility capabilities.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed API cache key generation and resolved edge-case handling issues in action and application processing.
- Resolved security vulnerabilities including prototype pollution attacks, improved rate limiting implementation, enhanced input validation, and enforced project capacity limits.
